title: poco-ai/Agentero: a local desk for papers and agents
friendlyTitle: Agentero keeps papers and agent notes in one place
summary: Agentero is a MIT-licensed research workspace that keeps PDFs, notes, and agent context on the local machine. It gained about 175 stars on today's TypeScript trending list.
friendlySummary: Agentero is a free local app for reading papers and asking an agent about them. It was trending on GitHub today.
whyItMatters: You read the PDF. The agent gets structured Markdown and LaTeX for formulas, tables, and figures, plus notes linked to the paper, so you are not pasting the same file into a chat. It is meant to sit beside a library tool such as Zotero, not replace it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You keep the PDF. The agent gets a cleaner copy of the tables, formulas, and your notes, so you do not paste the same paper into chat. It is a companion to a reference library, not a replacement.
